# cloud_firestore

**Tag**: firebase, firestore, realtime, database, web, mobile

## 简介

Flutter plugin for Cloud Firestore, a cloud-hosted, noSQL database with live synchronization and offline support on Android and iOS.

## 官网

- 主页: https://firebase.google.com/docs/firestore
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/firebase/flutterfire/tree/main/packages/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/cloud_firestore
